 ‘Not a fashion accessory’: MP Congress leader sends legal notice to Kareena Kapoor over Quran pendant, seeks apology 
 Trending Punjab Murder Kolkata Techie Assault Bareilly Suicide Diwali AQI Pawan Kalyan Delhi Red Fort Blast Punjab Murder Kolkata Techie Assault Bareilly Suicide Diwali AQI Pawan Kalyan Delhi Red Fort Blast Punjab Murder Kolkata Techie Assault Bareilly Suicide Diwali AQI Pawan Kalyan Delhi Red Fort Blast ‘Not a fashion accessory’: MP Congress leader sends legal notice to Kareena Kapoor over Quran pendant, seeks apology 
 Edited by Prachi Kumawat / TNN / Nov 12, 2026, 10:03 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Abbas Hafeez, a spokesperson for Congress in Madhya Pradesh, has sent a legal notice to Kareena Kapoor BHOPAL: Madhya Pradesh Congress chief spokesperson Abbas Hafeez has sent a legal notice to actor Kareena Kapoor over her social media post featuring a pendant bearing Quranic verses, objecting to its display as a fashion accessory. Hafeez has demanded that the actor remove the pictures and issue an apology, claiming that the pendant holds religious and historical significance linked to the Begums of Bhopal. Explaining his objection, Hafeez said the pendant was associated with the heritage of the former princely state of Bhopal and was worn by its Begums as a matter of faith. He also clarified that his action was a personal matter and should not be linked to the Congress party or his political position. Hafeez said, "There is a pendant from the princely state of Bhopal, linked to the heritage of the Begums of Bhopal, which bears a verse from the Quran. For the Begums, this was a matter of faith, not a fashion accessory. It was customary for them to wear it while in seclusion... The way Kareena Kapoor has worn it, flaunting it as a fashion statement and posting pictures, is inappropriate, especially given the specific rituals associated with touching or reading verses from the Quran. " " In this sense, the post is objectionable. She should remove those pictures and offer an apology. That is the primary demand in the legal notice I have sent... The Congress party has no stance on this. This is a personal matter of mine. It should not be linked to my party, my ideology, or my political position." Advocate explains legal notice
 Hafeez's advocate, Mohammad Zafar, said the objection was not to Kareena wearing a pendant but to the Quranic verse depicted on it and the manner in which it was displayed on social media. "Our objection is not to the fact that Bollywood actress Kareena Kapoor wore a pendant—but rather to what is depicted on it. It features a verse from the Quran which is considered highly sacred. My client and all of us believe that this has hurt the sentiments of the entire Muslim community." "In our tradition, one must perform wudu (ritual ablution) before reciting this verse or even touching the Quran. Our primary objection concerns the way it was displayed on social media. Consequently, we are issuing this demand notice, requesting that it be removed." (With ANI inputs)
